newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr weakened against the dollar on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.
It posted the birr at a mean rate of 6.426 compared to 6.413 last week.

Against the pound, the birr was posted at a mean rate of 10.8342 from 10.7353; against the yen, the birr was traded at 0.055732 from 0.056106 and against the mark, the birr was traded at 4.1258 from 4.1257 last week.
